metadata.description: Partial audit checklist for non-boundary properties (batch 6)

checklist.title: Verify receipt generation accurately captures execution result status, gas used, and logs
detection_procedure: 1. Locate receipt creation in core/state_processor.go ApplyTransaction or MakeReceipt
2. Verify receipt status correctly reflects execution outcome:
a. Status = 1 for successful execution
b. Status = 0 for reverted/failed execution
3. Verify gasUsed is correctly computed from initial gas minus remaining
4. Check that logs are correctly extracted from statedb:
a. Logs ordered by log index
b. Log topics and data preserved exactly
5. Verify bloom filter generation for log topics and addresses
6. Check contract address is set correctly for CREATE transactions
7. Verify cumulative gas used is properly accumulated across transactions
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-ACTION-ST-CREATE-RECEIPT-001 -> Action ACTION-ST-CREATE-RECEIPT. Receipt is deterministically generated from execution result. Included in block header via receipts root.

checklist.title: Verify successful state transition completion requires full processing pipeline
detection_procedure: 1. Trace ApplyTransaction to verify all steps complete before return:
a. Message conversion and validation
b. EVM execution
c. Gas refund processing
d. Receipt generation
2. Verify return path requires successful receipt creation
3. Check no early return paths bypass processing steps
4. Verify state changes are properly journaled before completion
5. Check that successful completion implies valid receipt generation

executable_checks.assertion: Transaction application returns receipt on success

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-STATE-ST-COMPLETE-001 -> State STATE-ST-COMPLETE. Successful completion is the return point to block processing. Transaction fully processed with receipt generated.

checklist.title: Verify pre-execution validation failures correctly route to failed state without side effects
detection_procedure: 1. Locate pre-execution validation in core/state_transition.go preCheck()
2. Verify nonce mismatch routes to failure:
a. Expected nonce != transaction nonce causes ErrNonceTooLow or ErrNonceTooHigh
3. Verify insufficient balance check:
a. Balance < gas cost + value causes ErrInsufficientFunds
4. Verify gas limit validation:
a. tx.gas < intrinsicGas causes ErrIntrinsicGas
5. Check that all failure paths prevent any state modifications
6. Verify error is propagated without side effects
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-ST-NODE-STATE-ST-FAILED-001 -> State STATE-ST-FAILED. Pre-execution failures terminate without state changes. Nonce, gas, and balance checks occur before EVM entry.

checklist.title: Verify EVM execution entry point correctly initializes contract code and gas
detection_procedure: 1. Locate EVM entry in core/vm/interpreter.go Run()
2. Verify contract code is correctly loaded:
a. Code fetched from statedb for CALL
b. Init code provided for CREATE
3. Check initial gas is correctly set from message
4. Verify program counter starts at 0
5. Check memory and stack are initialized empty
6. Verify depth is correctly propagated for nested calls
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-STATE-EVM-START-001 -> State STATE-EVM-START. Entry point for EVM execution. Contract code and initial gas must be correctly set.

checklist.title: Verify call depth limit of 1024 is enforced to prevent stack overflow attacks
detection_procedure: 1. Locate depth check in core/vm/evm.go Call(), Create(), or related functions
2. Verify depth is incremented before nested call/create
3. Check depth limit constant is 1024
4. Verify depth >= 1024 causes immediate failure with ErrDepth
5. Check depth is correctly decremented after call returns
6. Verify depth check occurs before any gas is consumed by nested call
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-ACTION-EVM-CHECK-DEPTH-001 -> Action ACTION-EVM-CHECK-DEPTH. Maximum call depth 1024 prevents call stack attacks and unbounded recursion.

checklist.title: Verify contract execution context is correctly initialized with caller, value, and gas
detection_procedure: 1. Locate NewContract in core/vm/contract.go
2. Verify caller address is correctly set from msg.sender
3. Check value (msg.value) is correctly stored
4. Verify gas is correctly propagated from caller
5. Check code and codehash are correctly set
6. Verify self address is correctly determined (CREATE or CREATE2)
7. Check jumpdest analysis is performed on code
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-ACTION-EVM-CREATE-CONTRACT-001 -> Action ACTION-EVM-CREATE-CONTRACT. Contract context has reference to caller, value, gas, and code. Context correctness is essential for CALLER, CALLVALUE opcodes.

checklist.title: Verify main execution loop correctly processes opcodes with gas metering
detection_procedure: 1. Locate main loop in core/vm/interpreter.go Run()
2. Verify each iteration follows the pipeline:
a. Fetch opcode at PC
b. Lookup operation from jump table
c. Check stack requirements
d. Calculate and charge gas
e. Expand memory if needed
f. Execute operation
3. Check loop termination conditions (STOP, RETURN, REVERT, error)
4. Verify no opcodes can bypass gas metering
5. Check loop correctly handles end of code
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-STATE-EVM-INTERPRETER-LOOP-001 -> State STATE-EVM-INTERPRETER-LOOP. Main execution loop processes opcodes sequentially with proper gas metering at each step.

checklist.title: Verify opcode fetch correctly handles program counter bounds and code end
detection_procedure: 1. Locate opcode fetch in core/vm/interpreter.go or core/vm/contract.go
2. Verify PC bounds checking:
a. PC >= len(code) returns STOP (0x00)
b. No out-of-bounds memory access
3. Check GetOp function behavior at code end
4. Verify PC is correctly maintained across iterations
5. Check PUSH opcodes correctly read immediate bytes
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-ACTION-EVM-FETCH-OPCODE-001 -> Action ACTION-EVM-FETCH-OPCODE. PC bounds are checked. Reading past code end returns STOP (0x00) for safe termination.

checklist.title: Verify fork-specific jump table lookup correctly identifies undefined opcodes
detection_procedure: 1. Locate jump table definitions in core/vm/jump_table.go
2. Verify fork-specific jump tables exist (frontier, homestead, etc.)
3. Check undefined opcodes have nil or undefined marker
4. Verify lookup returns error for undefined opcodes
5. Check correct jump table is selected based on block rules
6. Verify new opcodes are only available in correct forks
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-ACTION-EVM-LOOKUP-OPERATION-001 -> Action ACTION-EVM-LOOKUP-OPERATION. Jump table has 256 entries. Undefined opcodes have nil handler leading to invalid opcode error.

checklist.title: Verify stack bounds checking prevents underflow and overflow
detection_procedure: 1. Locate stack validation in core/vm/interpreter.go or core/vm/stack.go
2. Verify each operation has minStack and maxStack defined
3. Check stack underflow detection (stack.len() < minStack)
4. Check stack overflow detection (stack.len() + pushCount > 1024)
5. Verify violations route to error state without execution
6. Check stack operations are atomic (no partial pop/push)
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-ACTION-EVM-CHECK-STACK-001 -> Action ACTION-EVM-CHECK-STACK. Max stack size 1024. Each operation has minStack/maxStack requirements.

checklist.title: Verify gas calculation correctly computes constant and dynamic gas costs
detection_procedure: 1. Locate gas calculation in core/vm/gas_table.go or individual operation gas functions
2. Verify constant gas is correctly defined for each opcode
3. Check dynamic gas calculations:
a. Memory expansion cost (quadratic)
b. Storage access cost (warm/cold via EIP-2929)
c. CALL value transfer cost
d. LOG data size cost
4. Verify gas overflow is handled correctly
5. Check all gas costs match EIP specifications
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-ACTION-EVM-CALCULATE-GAS-001 -> Action ACTION-EVM-CALCULATE-GAS. Gas calculation is deterministic. Dynamic gas for memory expansion, storage operations, etc. Undercharging enables DoS.

checklist.title: Verify gas deduction occurs before opcode execution to prevent free execution
detection_procedure: 1. Locate gas deduction in core/vm/interpreter.go or core/vm/contract.go
2. Verify UseGas is called before operation.execute()
3. Check gas deduction failure routes to out-of-gas error
4. Verify no operation executes before gas is deducted
5. Check contract.Gas is correctly decremented
6. Verify gas deduction is atomic with execution decision
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-ACTION-EVM-DEDUCT-GAS-001 -> Action ACTION-EVM-DEDUCT-GAS. Gas metering is pre-execution, not post. Failure routes to out-of-gas error state.

checklist.title: Verify memory expansion charges quadratic gas cost and prevents unbounded allocation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate memory expansion in core/vm/memory.go and gas calculation
2. Verify memory cost formula: 3 * words + words^2 / 512
3. Check memory expansion gas is included in dynamic gas
4. Verify memory can only grow, never shrink
5. Check memory size is word-aligned (32 bytes)
6. Verify large memory requests don't cause OOM (bounded by gas)
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-ACTION-EVM-EXPAND-MEMORY-001 -> Action ACTION-EVM-EXPAND-MEMORY. Memory cost: 3 * words + words^2 / 512. Quadratic cost prevents unbounded memory allocation.

checklist.title: Verify opcode execution is sandboxed and state changes go through StateDB
detection_procedure: 1. Locate operation execution in core/vm/interpreter.go
2. Verify all state modifications use statedb interface:
a. SSTORE -> statedb.SetState()
b. BALANCE modifications -> statedb.AddBalance/SubBalance()
c. Code deployment -> statedb.SetCode()
3. Check no direct memory/disk access outside EVM scope
4. Verify return value handling is correct
5. Check execution cannot affect other contracts except via calls
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-ACTION-EVM-EXECUTE-OPCODE-001 -> Action ACTION-EVM-EXECUTE-OPCODE. Opcode handlers are sandboxed. State changes go through StateDB interface.

checklist.title: Verify program counter increment and JUMP/JUMPI destination validation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate PC management in core/vm/interpreter.go
2. Verify PC increments by instruction size after execution
3. Check PUSH opcodes correctly skip immediate bytes
4. Verify JUMP validates destination is JUMPDEST:
a. Destination must be valid JUMPDEST opcode
b. Cannot jump into PUSH immediate data
5. Check JUMPI uses same validation for non-zero condition
6. Verify jumpdest analysis is performed on code
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-ACTION-EVM-INCREMENT-PC-001 -> Action ACTION-EVM-INCREMENT-PC. JUMPDEST analysis prevents jumping into PUSH data. Invalid jumps cause execution error.

checklist.title: Verify successful execution via STOP/RETURN persists state changes and returns data
detection_procedure: 1. Locate STOP and RETURN opcode handlers in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify STOP returns nil error and empty return data
3. Verify RETURN returns nil error with specified return data
4. Check state changes remain committed on success
5. Verify reaching end of code behaves like STOP
6. Check gas refund is correctly calculated for successful execution
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-STATE-EVM-EXECUTION-SUCCESS-001 -> State STATE-EVM-EXECUTION-SUCCESS. STOP returns empty, RETURN provides return data. All state changes persist.

checklist.title: Verify REVERT opcode correctly rolls back state changes and returns error data
detection_procedure: 1. Locate REVERT handler in core/vm/instructions.go
2. Verify REVERT triggers snapshot revert in statedb
3. Check all state changes in current call frame are rolled back
4. Verify return data (error message) is preserved for caller
5. Check gas consumed is not refunded (unlike success)
6. Verify nested call reverts don't affect parent frame state
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-STATE-EVM-EXECUTION-REVERT-001 -> State STATE-EVM-EXECUTION-REVERT. REVERT triggers snapshot revert. State rolled back but return data available to caller.

checklist.title: Verify execution errors consume remaining gas and roll back state
detection_procedure: 1. Locate error handling in core/vm/interpreter.go
2. Verify all error paths converge to proper cleanup
3. Check remaining gas is consumed on error (not refunded)
4. Verify state changes are rolled back via snapshot
5. Check error propagation to caller is correct
6. Verify multiple error paths (OOG, stack, invalid op) behave consistently
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-STATE-EVM-EXECUTION-ERROR-001 -> State STATE-EVM-EXECUTION-ERROR. All remaining gas consumed on error (unlike REVERT). State changes rolled back.

checklist.title: Verify gas exhaustion correctly terminates execution and reverts state
detection_procedure: 1. Locate UseGas in core/vm/contract.go
2. Verify UseGas returns false when gas < cost
3. Check out-of-gas is detected during gas deduction step
4. Verify execution terminates immediately on OOG
5. Check ErrOutOfGas is returned to caller
6. Verify state is reverted on OOG
7. Check no partial execution occurs when gas runs out mid-operation
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-STATE-EVM-OUT-OF-GAS-001 -> State STATE-EVM-OUT-OF-GAS. Gas exhaustion detected during UseGas. Immediate termination, no partial execution.

checklist.title: Verify stack violations terminate execution with appropriate error
detection_procedure: 1. Locate stack validation in core/vm/stack.go or interpreter
2. Verify stack underflow check (stack.len() < minStack)
3. Verify stack overflow check (stack.len() + push > 1024)
4. Check ErrStackUnderflow and ErrStackOverflow are returned
5. Verify violations terminate execution before opcode runs
6. Check stack bounds are enforced for all opcodes
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EVM-NODE-STATE-EVM-STACK-OVERFLOW-001 -> State STATE-EVM-STACK-OVERFLOW. Stack underflow and overflow both terminate execution. Maximum stack size: 1024.
